name: Active filter summary
summary: Keeps active query refinements and scope visible while filter controls recompose.

name: Alert
summary: An in-page status or warning block with an icon, a heading, explanatory text and an optional action, readable without color.

name: Allocation
summary: Distribute a bounded amount across multiple choices while preserving direct numeric entry.

name: Application identity
summary: An application's own mark and name: an inline SVG mark that takes the theme accent, or an external mark with light and dark variants and a text monogram the browser shows natively when the asset fails to load.

name: Attention path
summary: Declares an intended first-glance priority path while preserving semantic source order and explicit text when visual emphasis channels are removed.

name: Badge
summary: Compact labels and metadata; status badges carry meaning in text with a redundant colored edge.

name: Best–Worst
summary: Capture distinct strongest and weakest choices without hiding the two-selection constraint.

name: Binary choice
summary: A two-option radio-backed answer that preserves Unanswered as distinct from false.

name: Bounded overflow
summary: A contained scroll region for genuinely wide content so the page itself never scrolls horizontally.

name: Button
summary: Native button (or a link styled as one) with a 44px minimum target and perceptual hover/press feedback; .forma-actions groups actions that wrap.

name: Callout
summary: Labelled note, caution, evidence, or decision inside prose; a visible label and rule pattern carry the kind without relying on color.

name: Card grid
summary: Ruled grid of cards with a column cap and content-driven column dropping; card links stretch without making the whole card the accessible name.

name: Character grid 3270 profile
summary: IBM 3270-inspired reference profile built only from public CharacterGrid contracts: a 24x80 operations menu with 3279-style palette tokens and block caret, verified at 32x80.

name: Character grid field
summary: Protected text and native editable fields placed on a character grid with explicit capacity, preceding labels, and shape-based required, invalid, disabled, and read-only cues.

name: Character grid keys
summary: Enter, Clear, Reset, PF1-PF24, and named action affordances as native buttons with visible key names; the application owns what each key does.

name: Character grid reveal
summary: Optional SequentialReveal presentation: a row-major clip mask over protected text already in the DOM, static by default and under reduced motion; orchestration stays in the application.

name: Character grid selection
summary: Per-row selection fields in positioned repeated rows (a 5250-style option column): native text inputs named by their column and row headers and described by the option legend; the application owns what each option does.

name: Character grid status
summary: Message and system-status live regions on a character grid with a visible severity word and shape cues that survive forced colors.

name: Character grid workflow
summary: Customer Inquiry, Account Detail, and Transaction History built only from public CharacterGrid contracts; transitions stay in the application.

name: Character grid
summary: Fixed rows-by-columns grid of equal-width cells where every run declares its cell coordinates and source order is row-major order; contained horizontal scroll by default.

name: Checkbox
summary: A native checkbox with a delegated touch target, non-color checked cue, and physics-derived CSS state motion.

name: Choice group
summary: Semantic single-choice option cards with a bold primary label and optional supporting text, backed by native radios.

name: Cluster
summary: Wraps related inline items while preserving semantic source order.

name: Code sample
summary: Technical sample in a captioned, keyboard-scrollable region that never widens the page.

name: Collection toolbar
summary: A responsive composition for search, filters, sort, saved views, and result counts.

name: Combobox
summary: Searchable selection baseline that preserves direct text entry and native semantics.

name: Command group
summary: Groups related commands under an explicit, visible task label without owning command authority.

name: Command palette
summary: Keyboard-first command discovery that can become a full-screen mobile surface.

name: Comparison grid
summary: Preserves cross-item comparison relationships in a bounded two-dimensional surface.

name: Comparison pairs
summary: Before/after or peer comparison that repeats labels and preserves the comparison task when columns collapse on narrow screens.

name: Composer
summary: Natural-language composition surface for type, dictate, paste, and attach workflows without embedding agent behavior.

name: Conflict review
summary: Explains an optimistic-concurrency conflict, shows what changed, and offers only application-supplied recovery actions.

name: Container
summary: Marketing-layer width container (narrow, default, wide, max) with a breakout escape for full-bleed media.

name: Conversation
summary: Inspectable user/application turns with explicit speakers and no consumer-chat authority assumptions.

name: Call to action
summary: Closing call to action with one primary action, optionally on an inverse surface tone.

name: Dashboard grid
summary: Responsive operational dashboard composition for metrics, status, and attention-first blocks.

name: Data grid
summary: Semantic tabular records with sortable-column affordances, contained horizontal overflow and a labeled record projection on phones.

name: Date range
summary: Paired direct date entry with reusable preset affordances and mobile stacking.

name: Date and time field
summary: Native date, time and datetime-local inputs in the .forma-field structure, keeping the platform picker and direct typed entry.

name: Dense ledger
summary: Compact expert-work table with bounded overflow, stable relationships, and explicit text state.

name: Diagnostic status
summary: Text-first presentation of synchronized, queued, unavailable, or failed diagnostic persistence state.

name: Diagram
summary: Presentation-only diagram nodes, connectors, metadata and key; the consumer owns geometry, routing, semantics and color mapping.

name: Dialog
summary: Modal presentation built on the platform dialog element and declarative invoker commands.

name: Diff viewer
summary: Before/after structured differences with explicit changed-field cues and stacked mobile comparison.

name: Disclosure
summary: Expandable content built on details and summary with no runtime behavior layer; where interpolate-size is supported the panel settles to its intrinsic height, otherwise it opens instantly.

name: Documentation layout
summary: Documentation page: navigation rail, prose article, and optional outline; navigation compacts to a wrapping list in narrow containers.

name: Emphasis budget
summary: Declares bounded primary, secondary, and supporting emphasis so competing regions cannot all claim the strongest visual priority.

name: Empty state
summary: Explains an empty result and offers a useful recovery action without treating absence as failure.

name: Entry index
summary: Ordered linked entries (research areas, products) that regroup from four columns to one by container width.

name: Evidence relationship
summary: Makes claim-to-evidence relationship type and scope explicit rather than relying on proximity alone.

name: Facts
summary: Short claims with supporting detail as a description list in a ruled, auto-fitting grid.

name: Fault banner
summary: Persistent page/application banner for degraded or critical Aegis conditions.

name: Fault blocking
summary: Native-dialog surface for Aegis Blocking intent with only application-supplied recovery actions.

name: Fault details
summary: Optional disclosure for explicitly approved and already-sanitized diagnostic values only.

name: Fault inline
summary: Operation-local Aegis fault presentation with reference and legal recovery actions.

name: Fault notification
summary: Persistent, dismissible notification surface for Aegis Notification intent; lifecycle remains application-owned.

name: Fault reference
summary: Short quotable Aegis reference with an optional application-owned copy action.

name: Fault summary
summary: Focusable grouped presentation of unresolved faults after upstream fingerprinting and deduplication.

name: Fault
summary: Common safe presentation shell for an Aegis Presentation.T without exposing raw fault diagnostics.

name: Feed item
summary: Compact chronological item with explicit identity, state, metadata, and owned actions.

name: File upload queue
summary: Native file selection plus a reusable upload queue for progress, success, cancellation, failure, and unknown outcomes.

name: Flyout
summary: Left/right edge modal surface built on native dialog semantics with reciprocal physics-derived motion.

name: Focus stage
summary: Dominant primary work surface with subordinate supporting context that stacks without semantic reordering.

name: Form row
summary: Peer form fields side by side whose controls share one top edge however long their labels, descriptions or validation messages are; fields wrap to new rows by available width.

name: Form
summary: A semantic, responsive native form contract with aligned fields, explicit submit/reset commands, native validation and observable script-free feedback.

name: Frame
summary: Constrains media to an explicit aspect ratio while keeping content contained.

name: Freshness
summary: States when evidence or data was last verified, with a machine-readable time and an explicit current or stale label.

name: Grid
summary: Foundation auto-fit grid that fills columns by a minimum track width and collapses to one column without media queries.

name: Handoff summary
summary: Exposes agent identity, proposal, uncertainty, evidence scope, and retained human authority.

name: Hero
summary: A page's first region: one promise, one primary action, and optional supporting context that stacks below it in source order.

name: Hierarchical choice
summary: Nested native disclosure and radio structure for choosing one item from a hierarchy, without assigning parent-child domain meaning.

name: Hierarchical multi-choice
summary: Multi-selection across a hierarchy with application-owned propagation and selection rules.

name: Hierarchy tree
summary: Uses semantic nesting and native disclosure for parent-child navigation without inventing tree behavior.

name: Icon
summary: Brand-neutral, zero-runtime inline SVG icons compiled from Forma's reviewed registry, with explicit decorative and accessible use.

name: Identifier & critical value
summary: Low-context identifiers, codes, numeric values, and consequential values with stronger glyph distinction and verification cues.

name: Image choice
summary: Choice cards that pair media with visible text while keeping the native radio or checkbox as the input.

name: Key-value list
summary: Description-list presentation of labelled values that stacks label above value on narrow screens.

name: Landmark region
summary: Creates a labeled semantic region for orientation and task ownership.

name: Lane board
summary: Preserves item-to-lane membership in a bounded board with narrow-screen containment.

name: Marketing shell
summary: Reusable marketing-site frame: skip link, identity header with wrapping navigation, main content, and footer. Sites own content; the shell owns structure, focus, and responsive behavior.

name: Master/detail workspace
summary: List-and-detail composition that collapses cleanly from multi-pane desktop to mobile navigation.

name: Single-choice matrix
summary: Repeated single-choice scales arranged as a matrix while retaining per-row radio semantics.

name: Measure
summary: Constrains readable line measure without changing semantic structure.

name: Action menu
summary: A Popover-backed ordinary action list with light physics-derived motion; full ARIA menu behavior remains application-owned.

name: Metric card
summary: A compact labeled value with context and optional action, without inventing metric meaning.

name: Metric value change
summary: A metric whose authoritative value updates immediately; a neutral perceptual tint marks the update without counting through invented numbers or implying direction.

name: Mobile action bar
summary: Safe-area-aware mobile action region that keeps one to three critical contextual actions reachable at the bottom of a narrow screen.

name: Mosaic
summary: Asymmetric editorial composition using explicit spans and deterministic narrow-screen reflow.

name: Multi-choice
summary: Checkbox-backed selection with explicit guidance for minimum, maximum, or exclusive choices.

name: Navigation shell
summary: Preserves current location and destination identity across persistent and compact navigation modes.

name: Numeric stepper
summary: Bounded numeric entry using the native number input and explicit constraints.

name: Obligation panel
summary: Presents unresolved work, evidence needs and blocking status without making the design system authoritative.

name: Operation status
summary: Presents pending, confirmed, failed, conflict, unknown, reconciling, stale, blocked, unavailable or insufficient outcomes with explanation and recovery actions.

name: Ordinal scale
summary: One radio-backed contract for ordered Likert, agreement, confidence, frequency, and similar scales.

name: Overflow command disclosure
summary: Moves secondary commands into explicit native disclosure without shrinking targets or hiding group meaning.

name: Overview disclosure
summary: Keeps consequential state, scope, uncertainty, and unresolved work visible while secondary evidence uses native disclosure.

name: Pagination
summary: Page navigation with explicit current-page semantics and compact mobile presentation.

name: Pairwise choice
summary: A focused two-alternative comparison using ordinary choice semantics.

name: Path summary
summary: Provides an ordered textual representation of a selected relationship or evidence path.

name: Popover
summary: Top-layer supplemental content built on the Popover API, opened by a native button with no script.

name: Preview surface
summary: A bounded review surface for consequential content before an application commits or publishes it.

name: Priority stack
summary: Responsive composition where priority changes space allocation but never DOM or semantic order.

name: Progress bar
summary: Native determinate progress projected directly from the authoritative value (never overshoots), plus a browser-owned indeterminate variant with explicit text.

name: Prose
summary: Long-form content constrained to the reading measure with underlined links and consistent heading rhythm.

name: Provenance trail
summary: Trace displayed output through source, aggregate, analysis, and presentation stages.

name: Question shell
summary: A stable prompt, help, selector, and validation structure for assessment questions.

name: Rail
summary: Supporting rail plus flexible primary region with start/end placement and single-column reflow.

name: Range entry
summary: Direct lower/upper endpoint entry; graphical dual-thumb behavior is an optional application enhancement.

name: Ranking
summary: Ordered-choice presentation with non-drag movement controls and visible positions.

name: Readiness checklist
summary: Explicit complete, incomplete and blocking prerequisites shown before a consequential transition.

name: Record header
summary: Persistent record identity, status, context, breadcrumbs, and legal actions with mobile action collapse.

name: Recovery actions
summary: Native buttons annotated with Aegis capability identity; current authority is revalidated on activation.

name: Relationship index
summary: Provides a semantic non-spatial index of entity relationships and their direction.

name: Reorder states
summary: Presentation hooks for dragging, displaced siblings, drop candidates, accepted/rejected drops and post-release settling.

name: Resizable split pane
summary: Split pane whose application-supplied size tracks drag or keys directly, settles without overshoot, and is clamped to legal bounds in CSS.

name: Responsive grid
summary: Auto-fitting composition grid with optional visual spans that collapse without changing source order.

name: Rule builder
summary: Field/operator/value clauses for typed rule editing while the application owns expression semantics.

name: Scope trail
summary: Keeps parent and current scope explicit as users move through nested or scaled representations.

name: Scroll progress
summary: Decorative reading-progress bar driven directly by the scroll timeline: no smoothing or lag, absent without scroll timelines or under reduced motion.

name: Search
summary: Search entry, clearing, and result-count feedback with asynchronous behavior owned by the application.

name: Section heading
summary: Labels a page section with an eyebrow, heading, framing sentence, and optional aside that wraps on narrow screens.

name: Section
summary: Vertical page-section spacing primitive; inside the marketing shell it also carries tone and child rhythm.

name: Security blockers
summary: Presents security conditions that block a transition without inventing remediation authority.

name: Security evidence age
summary: Makes security evidence freshness and staleness explicit.

name: Security evidence chain
summary: Shows the provenance chain supporting a security conclusion.

name: Security exception
summary: Presents an explicit security exception, its scope, status, and governing evidence.

name: Security invariant result
summary: Reports invariant evaluation outcomes with explicit state rather than color-only pass/fail cues.

name: Security posture
summary: Summarizes security posture while preserving unresolved, unknown, and blocking conditions.

name: Security state matrix
summary: Counts security results by explicit state (Verified, Violated, Unknown, Stale, N/A) so no state collapses into another or into a score.

name: Security trend
summary: Presents security change over time with state and context independent of color.

name: Security unknown
summary: Represents unknown security state explicitly instead of collapsing it into failure or success.

name: Segmented control
summary: Radio-backed compact selection with visible selected and focus states; where supported, one light-inertial selection indicator travels between segments without delaying native selection.

name: Select
summary: An ordinary native select with platform picker behavior and physics-derived CSS affordance motion.

name: Semantic differential
summary: A bipolar textual scale that keeps the ordered response radio-backed and explicit.

name: Sidebar
summary: Composes a supporting region with primary content and deterministic source-order reflow.

name: Site footer
summary: Closing identity, actions, secondary navigation, and legal note on a surface tone.

name: Site header
summary: Identity and primary navigation that wraps instead of hiding links, keeps 44px targets, and marks the current page with a non-color rule.

name: Skeleton
summary: Low-information loading placeholder with explicit busy semantics; its shimmer is a named cadence that runs only while aria-busy is true and stops for reduced motion.

name: Skip link
summary: First focusable link that jumps to main content; visually hidden until focused.

name: Slider
summary: Single-value range input with accessible bounds and direct keyboard/pointer control.

name: Spatial canvas
summary: Provides a bounded spatial exploration surface with orientation and a non-spatial access path.

name: Special choice
summary: Unknown, not-applicable, and other non-scale answers visually separated from the primary continuum.

name: Spinner
summary: Indeterminate activity with a visible label: constant-velocity cadence that stops when the application marks the activity idle, static under reduced motion.

name: Split pane
summary: Pairs related regions while preserving their semantic ownership and narrow-screen order.

name: Split
summary: Marketing-layer two-part layout: a dominant primary region and a supporting region that wraps below when space runs out.

name: Stack
summary: Applies consistent vertical rhythm between semantic siblings.

name: Start-up screen
summary: The first thing a script- or WebAssembly-driven application shows: its identity, indeterminate activity and a meaningful status, rendered from the initial HTML before any runtime exists, with slow, failed, timed-out and no-script states.

name: State survivability
summary: Projects explicit authoritative states with text and structural cues so unknown, stale, partial and unavailable do not collapse into one generic status.

name: Status lozenge
summary: Compact textual state label with a shape glyph and border, so state never depends on color.

name: Steps
summary: Numbered method or process using CSS counters on a native ordered list.

name: Surface
summary: A bounded panel with secondary surface tone, border and padding for grouping related content without inventing semantics.

name: Survey progress
summary: Determinate progress using the native progress element plus explicit current/total text.

name: Switch
summary: A checkbox-backed on/off preference control with role=switch and a visible track/thumb treatment.

name: Switcher
summary: Keeps related regions side by side when space permits and stacks them without semantic reordering.

name: Symbol rating
summary: Ordinal rating presented with symbols while retaining accessible textual labels.

name: Tabs
summary: Focused views with keyboard and deep-link integration hooks plus mobile overflow strategy.

name: Text field
summary: A labelled native text-like input (text, email, password, URL, tel, number) with optional description, using the .forma-field label/description structure.

name: Text roles
summary: Eyebrow, lead, statement and component kicker text roles that express hierarchy through type, not new semantics.

name: Textarea
summary: Multi-line native text entry with a visible label and description in the .forma-field structure; the browser owns resizing and form participation.

name: Timeline
summary: Chronological or ordered activity with timestamps, state changes, provenance, and single-column mobile flow.

name: Toast
summary: A Popover-backed transient notification with standard perceived weight and reciprocal dismissal.

name: Tooltip / contextual hint
summary: Supplemental hint on a native button: opens by click, tap or keyboard (popovertarget) and, where supported, on hover or focus (interestfor); light motion with a static reduced-motion substitute.

name: Understanding review
summary: Review proposed understanding, unknowns, conflicts, and source actions before consequential transitions.

name: Validation message
summary: Question- or field-level recovery guidance with a mark, bold text and no reliance on color.

name: Validation summary
summary: Focusable page- or form-level error summary with links back to each affected control.

name: Verification frame
summary: Recognize, deliberately verify, then act without letting presentation invent authority, certainty, or legal actions.

name: Visually hidden
summary: Keeps text available to assistive technology while removing it from the visual layout.

name: Wizard
summary: Step-by-step workflow shell with current-step state, progress, validation hooks, resume, and mobile reduction.

name: Work queue
summary: Attention-first list of unresolved work with reason, context, and application-supplied legal actions.

name: Workspace shell
summary: Composes navigation, primary work, contextual inspection, and status as explicit regions.
